targetTest: Updating a git marketplace whose host now needs a credential fails as authentication required - #2.1
expected: Each @github row (#2.1 = acme/tools, #2.2 = https://github.com/acme/tools) lists the failed child row tools@tools whose cause chain is Failed to update marketplace "tools"., The operation was canceled., the no credential was obtained for {git host} ... | git credential approve remedy, then fetched https://{git host}/acme/tools.git.
actual: Each @github row lists the cause chain Failed to update marketplace "tools"., The operation was canceled., fetched https://{git host}/acme/tools.git, with no remedy link; the step fails at the result lists these plugins.
semanticAssessment: Two scenarios ran, one per @github Examples row (#2.1 = acme/tools, #2.2 = https://github.com/acme/tools). Each published the marketplace, added it, armed the git host for the credential alice/s3cret, ran the update, and passed the result has these fields step (kind cascade, severity error, needs reload false, summary Some operations have failed.). Each failed at the result lists these plugins step on the cause chain cell alone: the actual chain lacks the git credential approve remedy between The operation was canceled. and the fetched URL. The diff shows every other compared cell equal (marketplace tools project failed, id tools@tools, reasons authentication required, cause truncated false). The @url row of the same Outline passed on the same code in a separate run (exit 0, 1 scenario passed), so the url arm already carries the remedy and only the github arm lacks it. No Pi start error, load fault, or undefined step.
